data.one_liner: Lightweight progress HUD widget for Flutter inspired by SVProgressHUD
data.what_it_does: Provides a loading HUD, success/failure indicators, progress HUD, and toast messages for Flutter applications. Can be used locally via widget context or globally above MaterialApp.
use_when: You need to show loading spinners or overlay messages during asynchronous tasks
You want a global progress indicator that can be triggered statically from anywhere
avoid_when: You require complex custom animations or rich design systems beyond standard HUD notifications
strengths: Supports both local widget tree placement and global setup
Easy to use API with methods for loading, success, error, progress, and toast
weaknesses: Only allows a single global HUD
